review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: complete base-to-head diff and PR metadata
selector models, validation, matching, resolver, cache, and collections
Accessibility query and action workers plus target identity
WeChat semantic list, open, read, action, focus, and send call paths
configuration, packaging, release proof, workflows, tests, and lifecycle docs
excluded_scope: real PyPI, TestPyPI, and GitHub Release publication

decision.rationale: The previous 12 findings are resolved, but four new blocking correctness and desktop-safety findings remain in public focus/send compatibility, AX target identity, row actionRef identity, and pagination continuation.

summary: The selector, cache, collection, privacy-proof, packaging, and live read/open remediation is effective, but public focus/send still uses an obsolete path, target-app-only AX requests can operate on the wrong app, conversation row actionRefs do not revalidate identity, and emitted page tokens cannot advance.

change_map.external_behavior: WeChat semantic APIs resolve mapped or selector Accessibility targets.
change_map.validation: Source review, package tests, prior counterexamples, and live semantic proof.

change_map.change: Add a warm query worker, indexed root resolution, AXPress/AXSetFocus, and frame-derived click fallback.
change_map.external_behavior: Reads and actions can target application Accessibility elements.
change_map.validation: Worker/action data-flow review and target identity analysis.

change_map.change: Migrate list/open/read paths while retaining legacy focus/send methods.
change_map.external_behavior: Existing consumers should retain contact switching, reads, and sends.
change_map.validation: Unit tests plus authorized live focus comparison.

findings.title: Public selector proof exposed private WeChat observations
findings.observation: The original proof copied full live observations into release assets.
findings.trigger: Generate and publish the original selector smoke report.
findings.impact: Contacts, messages, paths, and window data could become public.

evidence.description: Proof v2 now builds a whitelist-only public object and keeps raw live data only in an explicit private output.

findings.remediation: Completed: proof v2, forbidden-key/canary validation, and validate-before-copy bundling.
findings.verification: Strict preflight and sensitive canary tests pass; exact-code-head public proof contains no raw observation.

findings.title: Unknown search focus allowed keyboard input
findings.observation: Unknown focus previously advanced into clear, type, and Return.
findings.trigger: Accessibility could not identify the focused search field.
findings.impact: Contact text could be typed into the wrong editable target.

evidence.description: Current code accepts only state=verified and tests assert unknown states emit no text or Return.

findings.remediation: Completed: all unknown focus states fail closed.
findings.verification: WeChat package tests and live focus counterexamples stop before drafting or submitting.

findings.title: Fixed global coordinates could click unrelated UI
findings.observation: The original mapped path executed sampled screen coordinates before validating a current target.
findings.trigger: Move, resize, or relocate the WeChat window.
findings.impact: Navigation could click arbitrary desktop UI.

evidence.description: Current execution derives coordinates only from a just-queried in-window AX frame and verifies selected state afterward.

findings.remediation: Completed: fixed coordinate execution removed; current frame and postcondition required.
findings.verification: Frame containment and selected-state tests pass; live moved-window proof passed.

findings.title: Single-result lookup made contact ambiguity unreachable
findings.observation: The original mapped target query returned at most one same-name candidate.
findings.trigger: Two visible contacts share the requested display name.
findings.impact: The first candidate could be opened without disambiguation.

evidence.description: Current lookup requests two candidates and same-name fixtures fail before action.

findings.remediation: Completed: preserve two candidates and return contact_ambiguous before action.
findings.verification: Mapped and search duplicate-candidate tests pass.

findings.title: Unsupported helper mode reached selector operations
findings.observation: The helper skeleton did not implement selector AX operations.
findings.trigger: Construct a selector-backed WeChat tool with backend=helper.
findings.impact: Core semantic operations failed after construction.

evidence.description: Current configuration preserves backend identity and tool construction rejects helper mode before any transport command.

findings.remediation: Completed: unsupported helper mode fails fast; direct-backed service remains supported.

findings.title: Cache hits did not reapply selector predicates
findings.observation: The original cache check validated only a partial signature.
findings.trigger: A same-role element replaced the cached target at the same path.
findings.impact: Resolution could return the wrong element as a cache hit.

evidence.description: Current cache validation rebuilds the candidate through the fresh matcher, state, action, constraint, relation, and signature path.

findings.remediation: Completed: full predicate revalidation and stale eviction.
findings.verification: Same-role reuse, action loss, state, relation, frame, and expiry tests pass.

findings.title: Backend query failures were mapped to not-found
findings.observation: Availability, cause, and retryability were discarded from failed query payloads.
findings.trigger: Permission, timeout, or transport failure produced no nodes.
findings.impact: Callers received selector_not_found and chose the wrong recovery path.

evidence.description: Normalized outcomes now preserve backend cause and stop traversal as selector_query_failed.

findings.remediation: Completed: preserve available, failure kind, message, and retryability.
findings.verification: Permission, timeout, transport, and successful-empty tests pass.

findings.title: Batch field depth exceeded the AX client maximum
findings.observation: Packaged item and field depths combined to 11 while the client maximum was 8.
findings.trigger: Batch extraction ran for contacts, conversations, or messages.
findings.impact: The optimization failed normalization or regressed to many field queries.

evidence.description: A shared depth limit caps combined batch requests and packaged profile batch tests use the real normalizer.

findings.remediation: Completed: shared maximum depth 8 and bounded batch planning.
findings.verification: Packaged contact, conversation, and message batch tests pass.

findings.title: Normal pagination lookahead was treated as truncation
findings.observation: The N+1 limit sentinel inherited backend truncated=true.
findings.trigger: At least N+1 accepted rows were visible.
findings.impact: A complete page was returned as partial/failed.

evidence.description: Current code clears limit truncation only when the complete lookahead candidate is present and retains real time-budget truncation.

findings.remediation: Completed: distinguish completed limit lookahead from incomplete traversal.
findings.verification: N, N+1, and time-budget cases pass.

findings.title: Declared dependency floors lacked required selector surfaces
findings.observation: Old dependency floors could resolve packages without selectors or selector_profile_path.
findings.trigger: Install the new WeChat wheel with an allowed 0.1.x dependency set.
findings.impact: Installation succeeded but import/configuration failed at runtime.

evidence.description: All three packages are coordinated at 0.2.0, dependency floors require 0.2.0, and wheel checks reject a local 0.1.1-only dependency set.

findings.remediation: Completed: coordinated versions and clean mixed-version rejection proof.
findings.verification: Wheel build/install/import/API smoke and dependency rejection pass.

findings.title: Release workflow omitted the computer-use source root
findings.observation: WeChat release tests could not import computer_use_macos.selectors in a clean environment.
findings.trigger: Run the release test command without editable workspace packages.
findings.impact: Release publication failed during test discovery.

evidence.description: The release command includes all source roots and release preflight has a removal regression test.

findings.remediation: Completed: add the backend source root and protect it with preflight.
findings.verification: Clean source-path release commands and CI pass.

findings.title: Strict selector proof accepted zero-result extraction
findings.observation: The original strict check accepted true booleans with empty collections.
findings.trigger: Supply a success envelope with zero contact, conversation, and message evidence.
findings.impact: Release proof did not demonstrate the feature's extraction paths.

evidence.description: Current proof validation requires non-zero count-consistent collections, exact checks, source SHA, bounded timings, and privacy rules.

findings.remediation: Completed: strict proof v2 thresholds and structural consistency checks.
findings.verification: Zero, empty, mismatched, stale, slow, and sensitive negative tests pass.

findings.title: Public focus_contact and send_message remain on an obsolete live path
findings.observation: open_contact uses verified selectors, but focus_contact still uses a hotkey plus coarse observe and send_message still calls focus_contact.
findings.trigger: Call focus_contact or send_message for the authorized File Transfer target on the current WeChat client.
findings.impact: The public contact-switch operation returns search_not_focused and the convenience send flow cannot reach draft or submit.

evidence.description: Live focus-only smokes failed before typing with both Command+F (1781 ms) and Command+K (1278 ms); no draft or submission occurred.
_send_message directly invokes _focus_contact instead of the verified _open_contact path.

findings.remediation: Make focus_contact delegate to or share open_contact's selector-backed contract and make send_message use that verified target switch.
findings.verification: Add call-sequence tests and run authorized live focus and send proof to File Transfer with title verification before draft/submit.

findings.title: Target-app-only AX requests can read or act on the wrong frontmost application
findings.observation: Query and action worker scripts compare only bundleId and otherwise return the frontmost application without checking targetApp.
findings.trigger: Use an allowlisted app name without a configured bundle id while a different app is frontmost.
findings.impact: Queries can return another app's UI and actions can press a same-path element in the wrong application.

evidence.description: Both selected_running_app implementations return frontmost when REQUEST.bundleId is empty; action allowlist accepts an allowlisted target_app with no bundle mapping.
Public method signatures make bundle_id optional, while the AX design requires process selection by bundle id.

findings.remediation: Resolve the configured expected bundle or verify requested app identity before any AX read/action; reject unallowlisted query identities and fail closed when identity is unprovable.
findings.verification: Add wrong-frontmost target-app-only query/action tests, bundle mismatch tests, and a positive configured-name-to-bundle test with no worker call on failure.

findings.title: Conversation-row actionRefs can press a different contact after list reordering
findings.observation: AXRow actionRefs omit labelIn even when the target stores a contact-bearing label; the low-level executor receives only the weaker preconditions.
findings.trigger: Execute a listed row actionRef after unread or pinned state moves a different AXRow to the same path within the five-minute TTL.
findings.impact: execute_action can open and report success for a different contact, enabling subsequent reads or drafts against the wrong chat.

evidence.description: A current-head AXRow actionRef with a contact label contained only roleIn, actionIn, and enabled preconditions.
The actionRef lifecycle requires app/window/signature revalidation before execution.

findings.remediation: Publish row refs only when current semantic identity can be revalidated; otherwise omit the ref and require open_contact(displayName).
findings.verification: Simulate same-role path reuse with a changed label and assert no AXPress/fallback; retain positive unchanged and unlabeled no-ref cases.

findings.title: Visible-window list APIs return continuation tokens that repeat the first page
findings.observation: pageToken is parsed and echoed but never affects root, offset, scroll state, or query; both list paths fabricate a next token when more rows are visible.
findings.trigger: Pass the returned nextPageToken into a second list call while the UI remains unchanged.
findings.impact: The same rows and equivalent token repeat, producing duplicates or an unbounded agent loop.

evidence.description: page_token has no consumer beyond serialization, while tokens are synthesized from section and snapshot at lines 699 and 778.
The approved visible-window MVP contract requires next_cursor to remain None.

findings.remediation: Keep nextPageToken null and reject unsupported token input, or implement and verify real scroll/cursor continuation before advertising it.
findings.verification: Add a two-call test that rejects unsupported input or returns a disjoint second page, and assert a repeating token cannot be emitted.

required_actions.action: Unify public focus/send with the verified selector-backed open_contact path and run authorized live target/send proof.
Enforce target application identity before AX query or action.
Revalidate conversation row identity or stop publishing the actionRef.
Remove false continuation tokens or implement real continuation.

limitations: The report is valid only for head eb0e793b04dc05c4c9e1773380d73990a3d6dcbb.
Live operations were limited to the authorized WeChat target and stopped before drafting or submitting.
The exact public selector proof belongs to code head 6a74c1d677c767bc68b993f038739fe092c9c204; final exact-head proof must be regenerated after fixes.
Unrelated dirty and untracked workspace files were excluded.
open_questions: Should unsupported pageToken input return invalid_input or remain an always-null compatibility field until scrolling exists?
Should conversation row actionRefs be omitted in 0.2.0 or can WeChat expose a stable current row signature?
assumptions: Existing focus_contact and send_message behavior is part of the compatibility contract.
target_app identifies the requested app even when bundle_id is omitted.
An actionRef authorizes only its represented semantic target, not any later same-role element at the same AX path.
Visible-window extraction must not advertise a cursor that cannot advance.
